# wepoll

epoll for Windows: [piscisaureus/wepoll](https://github.com/piscisaureus/wepoll),
release **v1.5.8**, unmodified (`wepoll.c`, `wepoll.h`, `LICENSE`).

kronknet builds it on Windows only, behind `src/platform/win32/poller.c`.
To update it, replace the three files with the ones of a newer release.
